title: Full Mouth Reconstruction in Türkiye: Bone Grafts, Sinus Lifts & Healing

metaDescription: Understand bone grafts, sinus lifts, CBCT 3D scans, healing timelines, and soft-food planning for full mouth reconstruction in Türkiye.
quickAnswer: Full mouth reconstruction in Türkiye often requires two separate trips when jawbone volume is too thin for immediate implants. Bone grafting or a sinus lift typically adds three to six months of biological healing before final prosthetics. A 3D CBCT scan is mandatory before any clinic can confirm safe surgical scope or final pricing.
category: Dental Care in Türkiye — Implants, Veneers & Crowns (ITO Advisory)

body.text: Who needs bone grafting or a sinus lift before implants?

Patients with long-standing missing teeth, advanced periodontal bone loss, or low-hanging maxillary sinus cavities often lack the jawbone height or width needed to anchor titanium implants securely. An oral surgeon adds bone graft material—or gently lifts the sinus membrane during a sinus lift—to rebuild a stable foundation before or during implant placement.

As explained by the [American Association of Oral and Maxillofacial Surgeons (AAOMS)](https://myoms.org/what-we-do/dental-implant-surgery/sinus-augmentation-preparing-sinuses-for-dental-implants/), sinus augmentation raises the sinus floor in the upper back jaw and packs graft material beneath it so future implants have sufficient bone depth. Smokers, long-term denture wearers, and patients who lost molars years ago are the most frequent candidates. Only an in-person surgical exam and 3D imaging can determine whether grafting is required in your jaw.
How do healing times extend when grafting is required?

When bone grafting or a sinus lift is required, total treatment timelines typically stretch from a standard three-to-four-month implant cycle to six to nine months across two or three visits. Graft material needs three to six months to fuse with native bone before implants can bear chewing force safely.

According to [AAOMS dental implant healing guidance](https://myoms.org/what-we-do/dental-implant-surgery/healing-process-for-dental-implants/), osseointegration—the biological fusion of the implant to surrounding jawbone—cannot be rushed without risking implant failure. International patients should plan travel dates around biological milestones rather than aggressive seven-day package promises.

body.text: Why is a CBCT 3D scan mandatory before final pricing?

A two-dimensional panoramic X-ray cannot measure jawbone thickness, bone density, or the exact position of facial nerves and sinus floors. A Cone-Beam Computed Tomography (CBCT) 3D scan reveals whether you need bone grafts, sinus lifts, or angled implants—making any final price quote issued without a CBCT scan unreliable.

The [American Dental Association (ADA) 2026 dental imaging recommendations](https://adanews.ada.org/ada-news/2026/january/new-ada-recommendations-confirm-dental-imaging-most-effectively-used-in-moderation/) confirm that targeted CBCT imaging is essential for presurgical implant planning when 2D radiographs cannot capture critical three-dimensional anatomy. Likewise, the [UK General Dental Council (GDC) guidance on dental treatment abroad](https://www.gdc-uk.org/standards-guidance/information-for-patients-public/going-abroad-for-dental-treatment) advises that a qualified dentist must assess you in person with full diagnostic records before finalizing any treatment plan or cost estimate. Verify that your chosen facility appears on the [Turkish Ministry of Health International Health Tourism Authorization list](https://shgmturizmdb.saglik.gov.tr/EN-69289/healthcare-providers-with-international-health-tourism-authorization-certificates.html).
How do you plan soft-food dining in Istanbul during dental recovery?

Istanbul is one of the easiest cities in Europe for post-surgical soft-food recovery because traditional Turkish cuisine centers on smooth soups, strained yogurts, stewed vegetables, and slow-cooked dishes. Planning hotel location and meal access in advance prevents accidental chewing trauma during the critical first week after surgery.
Use this practical Istanbul dental recovery checklist when organizing your stay:

items: Book a quiet hotel or serviced apartment with a kitchenette and elevator within 15 minutes of your clinic to minimize post-op transit.

Rely on warm—never scalding hot—Turkish staples such as mercimek çorbası (red lentil soup), yayla çorbası (yogurt-mint soup), patlıcan ezmesi (smooth roasted eggplant), and soft menemen (scrambled eggs with stewed tomato).
Avoid crusty simit, grilled kebabs, nuts, seeds, spicy pul biber, alcohol, and drinking through straws, which can disturb healing blood clots.
Pack a soft-bristled post-surgical toothbrush and follow your surgeon's exact rinse and medication schedule.
Schedule at least two buffer days before your return flight so your surgeon can check sutures and adjust temporary prosthetics.

faq.q: Can a full mouth reconstruction in Türkiye really be finished in one 5-day trip?
faq.a: Rarely. While immediate-load temporary teeth can sometimes be placed on Trip 1, final porcelain or zirconia bridges normally require three to six months of jawbone healing and a second trip.

faq.q: How much do bone grafts and sinus lifts add to implant costs in Türkiye?
faq.a: Depending on graft volume and surgical complexity, bone grafting typically adds €200 to €550 per site, while a sinus lift generally ranges from €300 to €650 per side.

faq.q: Can I fly right after a sinus lift procedure in Istanbul?
faq.a: Sinus lift patients face cabin-pressure precautions and strict instructions not to blow their nose or sneeze forcefully. Ask your oral surgeon for written clearance on your safe fly-home window before booking tickets.

faq.q: Should I get a CBCT scan in my home country before travelling?
faq.a: Bringing a recent DICOM-format CBCT scan helps shortlisted Turkish surgeons give more realistic preliminary ranges, though most clinics will still take an updated in-house scan upon arrival.

faq.q: What happens if my temporary bridge feels loose during recovery?
faq.a: Contact your treating clinic immediately rather than attempting home adjustments. Building two buffer days into your Istanbul itinerary gives your prosthodontist time to refine your bite before departure.
